name: Tsukishiro Hikari
source:
Hikari is the most knowledgeable person about all of the cities mysteries. In the game her route only opens after the four other girls’ routes have been cleared. She first forms a relationship with [url=/c471]Makoto[/url] when he rescues a cat from a tree; although Hikari is content to observe the world from a distance, [url=/c471]Makoto[/url]’s hands-on approach intrigues her.

[spoiler]Hikari is skilled with a katana, a good cook, and she enjoys painting the open sky. She tends to distances herself from other people because of a myriad of lies and given reasons; such as that she doesn’t want others to get hurt, or that strong people don’t need to rely on others. Yet in reality she longs for human interaction, but fears being rejected.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wind:_A_Breath_of_Heart]Wikipedia[/url]]
